techniques.evidence: src/app/api/dev/dev-surfaces-gated.test.ts:43 Inline run of the real stripper: the bracket-string read is not detected, the dot read is. The technique says a literal key needs the raw read; the sibling admission guard does exactly that. Seeds cover dot access only.
